en: Ah, a young trainer with a keen eye! You look like someone who'd put this to good use.
I've spent my life trimming trees and hedges. Here, take my favourite move. A gift from one cutter to another!
HM01 teaches Cut. It clears away the thin trees that stand in your way.
You'll need the Stone Badge from our Gym before your Pokémon will use it outside a battle, mind.
